newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Study shows the private sector in Saudi Arabia can raise $50 billion to finance infrastructure projects.
- The Philippines government has imposed a ban on the recruitment of Filipina housemaids, a senior Filipino diplomat said.

- Saudi judge Sheikh Salah ibn Humood gave the family of murdered Australian nurse three weeks to consider a conciliatory settlement rather than request the death penalty for two British nurses accused of killing their colleague.
- Saudi confirms its Boeing 747s are safe following calls from the U.S. company to carefully examine the central fuel tanks in the aircraft.
- Industry ministry approves 23 industrial projects worth 1.6 billion riyals.
- A second plane loaded with assistance arrives in Dhaka from Saudi to help victims of the cyclone.
- Assets of investment funds in Saudi-based banks increased to 15 billion riyals in May 1997, from 13 billion riyals a year earlier.
